erin (partnerships): Quick sync: Aurelia offered to run a joint sustained-efficiency sweep (tokens/sec per watt) + latency curve. Who can own measurement specs?
rick (eng-runtime): I can own orchestration and CSV outputs. Need to know power sampling rate and kernel variants.
sam (Aurelia Systems HW): We can provide 8 nodes, 1Hz power, and an "aurelia-prefetch" kernel build. We'll give an S3 bucket for telemetry.
leah (eng-ml): Models: 7B and 13B LMs. Test seq 512 and 1024, batch 1 and 4. Quants: q4_0 and q8_0. Capture 30 eval prompts for quality checks.
erin (partnerships): Marketplace blurb requires: sustained tokens/sec/W and 99p latency at p50 throughput. Also a short methods note.
rick (eng-runtime): Proposed run: 2 min warmup, 6 min measure, power @1Hz, collect per-token latency histogram. I'll publish runner example today.
sam (Aurelia Systems HW): Lab window M-F 08:00-16:00 PT. We need job schedule and SSH keys uploaded to our vault. Also need kernel-logs to aurelia-debug s3 for prefetch runs.
bench-bot: CI pipeline created: https://ci.redwood.ai/pipelines/aurelia-sweep (dry-run nightly). :robot_face:
leah (eng-ml): I'll prepare prompt packs and baseline outputs and flag any quality regressions.
erin (partnerships): Action items: @rick runner + CSV + CI, @leah promptset + eval, @sam provision nodes + s3 + kernel builds, partnerships drafts marketplace copy. Checkpoint Thu 9am PT.
sam (Aurelia Systems HW): Boards shipping tomorrow ETA 36h. Will ping once racked.
rick (eng-runtime): Posting runner PR shortly with CSV schema (tokens_sec, avg_power_w, p50/p95/p99 lat).
erin (partnerships): Thanks all 44d I'll calendar the Thu sync and start a draft blurb for review.
